summary: Native art materially improves toward the warm soft cartoon target and preserves the measured native contract. Approval is blocked by real consumer RGB/opacity seams after independent sprite filtering. Raw assembly equality does not establish consumer continuity, and no runtime correction is implemented.

inspectionMethods.direct: All four heroes; logical and enlarged four-facing sheets; all24 contact sheets; declared critical mip1 images; repeated assembled S0; all six declared Godot filter images.
inspectionMethods.animation: Opened previews/review.html in Chrome and inspected progressing single/native3/independent RGBA3/individually filtered motion in all four facing rows. Independently decoded all12 declared APNGs, verified all576 displayed frames against the native-frame or native/assembly pair pixels, and inspected all24-frame contact sheets extracted from the eight paired APNGs. Running APNG pixels equal the independently verified all24 single sheets.
inspectionMethods.registration: Inspected192x352 logical and384x704 native views and enlarged seam crops. Light/gray/dark raw and mip1 comparisons plus RGB/alpha local crops were inspected. Supplemental Godot imports were also composed over a light background at actual128 size and32 size enlarged4x for seam visibility.
inspectionMethods.scope: Independent judge read fixed prompt, unchanged frozen criteria, initial critique and actual evidence. No editor self-ratings or design rationale were used; no candidate/source/brief file was changed.

scoreNotes.shapeVolume: Soft slat shoulder shading and rail edge response give more volume than the source; shaped warm supports and shoes improve construction. Exact open rectangular profiles appropriately limit endpoint rounding.
scoreNotes.color: Coral rails, blue-charcoal slats and honey wood form a clear palette hierarchy. The support midtones are substantially more readable than the original near-black legs.
scoreNotes.lightingHighlights: Broad restrained gradients are coherent across all four views, without a glaring directional hot spot or native black dead region.
scoreNotes.materialDetail: Wood variation, shaped feet and small fasteners add readable native construction detail. The result is deliberately simpler and less glossy than the imagegen target.
scoreNotes.artifactFreeReadability: Individual/native raw readability is good, but the intended consumer has visible joining-rail breaks and significant alpha/color discrepancy. This score includes that blocking actual-use defect; it is not an aesthetic approval threshold.

observations.observation: The source dark-bar supports have become substantial honey-brown legs with shaped lower shoes, restrained wood variation and small fasteners. Deck stripes now read as softly crowned slats. Rail edges have a continuous warm highlight and front-facing rail depth remains readable in E/W. There is no material aesthetic blocker in the inspected native views.

All24 source times in all four native facings retain coherent material and geometry. Native3 and unmodified independently assembled RGBA3 run pixels have exactly equal alpha throughout100 samples including closure; local joins differ by at most1/255 premultiplied RGB. Phase travels coherently through both joins. The first and closure single-frame pixels match in all facings, with24 distinct pixel frames per facing.

Separately filtering source sprites before RGBA assembly creates seam-local rail color/opacity bands. N/S ideal mip1 has64.5/255 maximum alpha error and43.7588/255 premultiplied RGB error at joins; actual Godot generated-mip128 images show horizontal rail breaks at each module boundary. This is absent from the corresponding precomposed-then-filtered run.

Supplemental actual Godot tests using the game exact mipmaps/generate=true importer setting confirm discrepancy at both128-cell and32-cell sizes. Independently recomputed direct-versus-precomposed maxRGBA is[50,22,16,64] over260 differing pixels at128 and[38,20,24,60] over72 differing pixels at32. The no-mip default-import32 equality inside the packet is not evidence of a clean game consumer.

Nearest has different sampling results from its precomposed reference and has not been established as a drop-in solution. Precomposed filtering is a useful comparison image; a production compositor or equivalent correction has not been implemented. Neither can be assumed for approval.

blockers.location: Both joining boundaries of the N/S longitudinal rails; actual Godot S/frame0 generated-mip/imported-mip runs at cell128 and cell32 demonstrate the consumer failure. In the packet logical run comparison, join ROIs are[160,248,128,21] and[160,376,128,21].
blockers.effect: The connected conveyor visibly resolves into separate modules after independent texture filtering, with rail breaks and opacity/color bands. This violates the unchanged requirement for continuity in both RGB and alpha at intended use size despite the clean raw source-scale2 assembly.
blockers.desiredVisibleOutcome: The concrete accepted consumer must render a continuous rail/deck run at actual intended scales and filtering, with no seam-specific RGB or alpha band, notch, or double edge. Preserve the source profiles, camera, roots, ports and timing. Supply reviewed production-use evidence for all four facings, all24 times and closure after any correction; a proposed future compositor or unverified nearest setting is insufficient.
blockers.externalEvidence: Separate exact-game-import diagnostic listed in technicalEvidence.externalEvidence.

remainingDifferences: Rails retain straight open terminal profiles rather than the target rounded isolated end caps. This is necessary for the fixed modular connection contract.
Native rail/slat highlights are quieter and more regular than the target glossy bevels. They still give a meaningful warm soft cartoon improvement at logical size.
Wood grain and decorative joinery are simpler than the target. Readability and useful native support construction are adequate; copying target ornament counts or microtexture is unnecessary.

packetIntegrity.criteria: Packet qualityCriteria and brief frozen criteria match the original judge proposal except status changed to frozen-by-coordinator.

actualNativeInspection.method: Opened exact candidate round-08.blend and original b1765262bfa897ad source in separate in-memory Blender states without saving. Enabled dependency evaluation, measured publisher S/root0 geometry and compared endpoints directly. Bound the actual shader action and evaluated25 samples in each actual root rotation.
actualNativeInspection.camera: 384x704, pixel aspect[1.2206555604934692,1], actual world/projection matrices match source registered capture within float precision (reported max5.96e-8).
actualNativeInspection.lighting: Actual85W centered area at[0,0,4.5], size5; four equal30W cardinal area fills at XY radius3,z2.5,size4.

independentPixelChecks.atlases: All96 crops of four2304x2816 6x4 atlases equal their native384x704 source frames byte for byte.
independentPixelChecks.rawDifferenceLimit: The worst full-image RGB difference lies outside the joining ROIs: S0 has12 pixels over8/255 around y1021, not a continuous rail seam. No material visible raw defect was found there.

externalEvidence.purpose: Supplemental actual consumer diagnostic, inspected separately from packet-bound render/preview list. It confirms rather than replaces the packet known filtering failure.

limits: Supplemental actual Godot test samples S/frame0; it establishes a real failure but does not establish all-facing/all-time consumer success.

Packet imported32 local no-mip equality is not game importer parity; game project.godot explicitly generates mipmaps. Explicit generated-mip tests and the separate exact-import experiment are the relevant current-use evidence.
No production consumer correction is implemented or approved. No candidate re-render, model edit, brief change, integration or deployment was performed by this judge.
